name: Cornerstone VC
identity_check: Recorded as Cornerstone VC / Cornerstone Venture Capital (cornerstonevc.ai; site in English and Simplified Chinese; sitemap names cornerstonevc.com as canonical, which did not resolve), an early-stage investor in AI, gaming and entertainment whose four listed deals include three Bay Area startups (San Francisco, San Jose, Berkeley) in AI robotics and AI construction software. Chosen as the best match for the One Way Summit SF list entry 'Cornerstone VC — AI native' because of the .ai domain, the AI-first focus and the Bay Area portfolio. Attendance could NOT be confirmed: neither the summit site nor its announcement names any Cornerstone, and the firm never uses the words 'AI-native'. Main alternative, not excluded: Cornerstone VC of London (cornerstonevc.co; Cornerstone Venture Partners LLP, FCA 1009827; LinkedIn handle 'cornerstone-vc'), a pre-seed/seed fund for UK-based companies with diverse founding teams whose 2025-26 deals are mostly AI B2B. Ruled out: Cornerstone Ventures (Mumbai B2B SaaS, $200M Fund II), Cornerstone Venture Partners (New York/Israel B2B, cornerstonevp.com), Cornerstone AI (healthcare data company, not an investor), Cornerstone Robotics (a robotics company with its own round file). No Sydney 'Cornerstone VC' surfaced in searches.

thesis_text.value: Invests in technology and the human experience, concentrating on AI, gaming and entertainment companies it sees as raising quality of life and unlocking creativity. Looks for curious, high-integrity founders who keep upgrading their thinking; rooted in Christian values with a special interest in faith-driven entrepreneurs, though faith is not required. Three of its four listed deals are Bay Area startups.

open_items: Identity not proven. The summit list gives only 'Cornerstone VC — AI native'; no public page ties either Cornerstone to One Way Summit SF 2026 (summit pages 4-5 checked). The London firm (pages 6-8) (cornerstonevc.co) is a real alternative: £20m debut fund (first close 2022-08-03, BGF, Hg Foundation, Atomico), £250k-£1m initial cheques, pre-seed to pre-Series A, Managing Partner Rodney Appiah, 16 announced rounds in 2024-26 (Capsa AI, Monq, Sainaptic, Smart Bricks and others). If the attendee was that firm, this file should be redone for cornerstonevc.co.

HQ city and country are not published on cornerstonevc.ai (no address, no legal entity, no team page). Three of the four portfolio entries are tagged San Francisco, San Jose and Berkeley in the page data, and the apply form offers US (+1) and UK (+44) phone codes. One database listing (superscout.co, not used as a source) calls the firm UK-based, says it mainly invests in US startups and gives 2026 as the founding year; all three claims are unverified.
No partners, team or LinkedIn company page found. linkedin.com/company/cornerstone-vc belongs to the London firm, not this one.
No fund information (number, size, close date), check size, or statement on leading rounds published.

Only four investments are listed (Second Social 2026, DeepReach 2025, Quotr 2025, Bestmow 2024), with year and stage only; fewer than the 8 Tier A rounds exist publicly. No round announcement naming Cornerstone was found. A search-result hint (PitchBook, not fetched) listed xNova VC as DeepReach's only investor for a May 2025 deal.

Not stated: whether it invests in Indian founders or requires a US entity (the apply form only asks for location). The form accepts Pre-seed through Growth and lists Climate Tech as an industry option beyond the stated AI, gaming and entertainment focus.
The sitemap and robots.txt point to cornerstonevc.com as the canonical domain; that domain did not resolve on 2026-10-30.
